title: Auto Scaling Web Application on AWS
description: Designed and deployed a production-grade auto-scaling architecture on AWS: custom VPC with public/private subnets across 2 Availability Zones, ALB, Auto Scaling Group (min 2 / max 6 EC2 instances), and CloudWatch-driven scaling policies. Built a Golden AMI strategy to eliminate the NAT Gateway, saving ~-35/month with zero internet dependency at boot. Flask v3 dashboard with live instance metadata and /load simulation.
